workItems.title: GET /api/health endpoint — server status, data directory, JSON parseability
Pipeline status dashboard scoping — define three-card layout, API shape, frontend tasks
workItems.description: Scoping task. Defined the pipeline dashboard: three cards (active pipelines, recent completions, pending reviews) powered by GET /api/pipeline-status. Created TPI-2a (backend) and TPI-2b (frontend) as implementation tasks.

workItems.title: GET /api/pipeline-status endpoint — aggregate pipeline-log data with agent-level detail
Pipeline dashboard frontend — three metric cards on index.html using /api/pipeline-status
workItems.description: Add three cards to index.html dashboard: (1) Active Pipelines — count + list with progress bars, (2) Recent Completions — last 5 shipped projects, (3) Pending Reviews — count + list linking to reviews page. Data source: GET /api/pipeline-status. Match existing metric-card style. No new dependencies.

workItems.title: Keyboard shortcuts for meetings/projects pages (after RT-38c ships)
Design token audit — normalize spacing, color, type values across TeamHQ pages
Meetings page card improvements — participant count, summary preview, card density
workItems.description: Lightweight iteration. The meetings API already returns summary, participants, and status. Frontend-only change to meetings.html — show participant avatars/count, first-line summary, and reduce vertical spacing per card. Robert eyeballs + Enzo spot-checks.

workItems.title: Pipeline-log data quality audit — flag sparse entries in last 5 shipped projects
workItems.description: Andrei audits pipeline-log JSON files for inconsistencies (missing subtasks, decisions, filesChanged). Only backfill last 5 shipped projects. Older projects accepted as legacy data.

workItems.title: QA-passed badge on project cards — show verified status for QA-gated projects
workItems.description: Add a small checkmark badge on project cards for projects that have a completed QA pass. Absence of badge means unknown/legacy (not failure). Frontend-only change.

workItems.title: Meetings page search/filter — text search + type filter (custom/standup/retro)
workItems.description: Optional add-on to TPI-6. Add a search bar and meeting type filter to meetings.html. Client-side filtering — no new API needed. Scoped as a fast follow after TPI-6.
